findings.excerpt: <select value={source.status} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => void act({ action: "update-source", sourceId: source.id, patch: { status: event.target.value as ResearchSourceRef["status"] }, })} >

<select id="research-studio-config-guest-voice" className="research-studio__select focus-ring" value={mediaGuestVoice} aria-describedby="research-studio-config-guest-voice-help" aria-invalid={mediaConfigurationError ? true : undefined} aria-errormessage={ mediaConfigurationError ? "research-studio-config-media-error" : undefined } onChange={(event) => onMediaGuestVoiceChange(event.target.value) } >

<select id="research-studio-config-length" className="research-studio__select focus-ring" value={mediaLength} aria-describedby="research-studio-config-length-help" aria-invalid={mediaConfigurationError ? true : undefined} aria-errormessage={ mediaConfigurationError ? "research-studio-config-media-error" : undefined } onChange={(event) => onMediaLengthChange(event.target.value as ResearchMediaLength) } >

<select id="research-studio-config-local-voice" className="research-studio__select focus-ring" value={mediaVoice} aria-describedby="research-studio-config-voice-help" aria-invalid={mediaConfigurationError ? true : undefined} aria-errormessage={ mediaConfigurationError ? "research-studio-config-media-error" : undefined } onChange={(event) => onMediaVoiceChange(event.target.value)} >

<select id="research-studio-config-provider" className="research-studio__select focus-ring" value={mediaProvider} aria-describedby="research-studio-config-provider-help" aria-invalid={mediaConfigurationError ? true : undefined} aria-errormessage={ mediaConfigurationError ? "research-studio-config-media-error" : undefined } onChange={(event) => { const provider = event.target.value as ResearchMediaProvider; onMediaProviderChange(provider); onMediaVoiceChange( provider === "local" ? (readiness?.providers.local.voices[0]?.id ?? "") : (readiness?.providers.elevenlabs.defaultVoiceId ?? ""), ); }} >
<select id="research-studio-config-source" className="research-studio__select focus-ring" value={selectedSourceId ?? ""} onChange={(event) => onSelectSource(event.target.value)} >

<select id="research-studio-config-style" className="research-studio__select focus-ring" value={mediaStyle} aria-describedby="research-studio-config-style-help" onChange={(event) => onMediaStyleChange(event.target.value as ResearchPodcastStyle) } >
<select id="research-studio-source" className="research-studio__select focus-ring" value={effectiveSourceId ?? ""} onChange={(event) => setSourceId(event.target.value)} >
